title: The Chokehold and the Magicians Test — Part 5

series.summary: Hisoka evaluates Gon after the boy's strike. When Gon attacks again, Hisoka seizes him by the throat, admiring his fearless glare. After knocking out an intervening Leorio, Hisoka spares both boys and carries Leorio toward the finish line.

segments.voiceover_text: Hisoka studies the boy with dark amusement. Gon lunges again, whipping his fishing rod in fierce strikes, but Hisoka slips past every blow like smoke.
Hisoka closes the distance and clamps a hand around Gon's throat, lifting him into the air. Despite suffocating, Gon glares back with furious, unbroken defiance.
Leorio charges back to protect his friend, but Hisoka casually decks him with a thunderous right hook, knocking Leorio out cold on the grass.
Rather than killing them, Hisoka smiles and declares both boys have passed his test. He slings Leorio over his shoulder and strolls into the fog.
